title: Reboot gaming hub opened at Queen's University Belfast
summary: Queen's University Belfast recorded that Reboot, a new gaming hub with retro arcade, board-gaming, console, VR, cafe, and esports spaces, opened at 92 Lisburn Road on 19 August 2024.
observed_change: A Queen's University Belfast public-facing gaming and esports venue entered documented use at 92 Lisburn Road.
source_date_field: Queen's news page dated 20 August 2024 states the facility opened on Monday 19 August.
architect: Queen's University Belfast, Geek Retreat, Reboot gaming hub project team; architect not named in source page
project_type: university gaming, esports, and public cultural/leisure facility
geometry_source: Curated point from the source-stated 92 Lisburn Road location.
geometry_precision: Approximate address point, not a measured ground-floor, mezzanine, first-floor, esports room, cafe, or building footprint.
limitations: The event records the opening of a named university gaming hub; it does not document original construction of the Lisburn Road building, detailed fit-out completion, later operating hours, event programming, or commercial performance.

title: Ulster University Belfast Sports Centre opened at Nelson Place

observed_change: A purpose-built university sports centre with gym, sports hall, wellness, spin, rooftop running-track, and training spaces entered documented use at Nelson Place.
source_date_field: Ulster University November 2024 news page states the Belfast Sports Centre opened in September 2024.
architect: Fletcher Joseph Associates, Ulster University Sport, Student Roost, GRAHAM, and Nelson Place sports-centre project team
